feature: Rename identified speakers from transcript gestures

scenarios.name: Long press an identified speaker to rename
scenarios.given: an iPhone or iPad transcript contains identified participants
scenarios.when: the reader long presses a speaker, saves a new name, or cancels the editor
scenarios.then: the existing identity is renamed throughout the conversation and in Notes; other speakers remain unchanged and cancellation has no effect; Save and Cancel remain reachable at accessibility text sizes, and a saved name survives rotation

manual.reason: Device layout and gesture usability require rendered inspection
steps: Inspect compact, expanded and Duo transcript rename controls with VoiceOver and large text.

scenarios.name: Double click an identified Mac speaker
scenarios.given: a Mac transcript has an identified speaker label
scenarios.when: the user double clicks that label or opens Rename speaker from its menu
scenarios.then: the speaker editor opens for that identity; ordinary single clicks and disabled labels cannot request a rename; live breakdown voices remain nameable before transcript attribution, restored identities update all matching lines, and unknown identities change nothing; delayed finalized lines retain chronological display order, recording identity, capture times and editing identity after renaming

manual.reason: Native control tests do not prove the complete installed SwiftUI sheet binding
steps: Double click an identified speaker label in the installed Mac transcript, save a new name, and verify all matching lines and a reopened conversation use it.
Cancel a rename and verify no change; changing conversation while editing must not rename another conversation.
